deal_summary: The customer clarified that it needed applicators integrated into an existing conveyor, not a complete standalone labeling line; production said it could not implement that integration, and the customer said it was not proceeding with the offered full-system alternative at this time (evidence 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5).

customer_need.summary: A manager log describes a 10-liter flat canister with two side labels and a 1,000-per-hour target; the customer later clarified that it wanted applicators added to an existing line (evidence 0, 1, 3).

deal_dynamics.early: The customer supplied a canister sketch and label dimensions; the seller prepared a complete equipment proposal and video (evidence 1, 2).
deal_dynamics.middle: The customer said the proposal's conveyor did not fit the need because an existing conveyor was already in place; the customer promised a video of the line (evidence 3, 4).
deal_dynamics.late: After reviewing that video, production said it could not install the seller's applicators in the existing line and offered only a complete-system configuration; the customer said not this time (evidence 4, 5).

positive_signals: The customer supplied drawings and labels and reviewed the proposal (evidence 1, 2).
The customer eventually sent a video showing the existing line (evidence 4).
negative_signals: The customer rejected the offered complete-line alternative for the current need after integration was found infeasible (evidence 5).
customer_behavior.initiative: The customer clarified the existing-line requirement and sent a video to support technical assessment (evidence 3, 4).
customer_behavior.decision_process: The decision turned on whether the applicators could fit the customer's existing conveyor; the customer did not accept replacing that setup with a full system in the visible exchange (evidence 3, 5).

strong_actions: The seller sent a proposal and asked for a video of the customer's production line to assess the integration (evidence 2, 3, 4).
The seller consulted production and relayed its technical limitation directly (evidence 5).
weak_actions: The first proposal included a standalone conveyor although the customer's clarified requirement was to reuse the existing conveyor (evidence 2, 3).
manager_behavior.follow_up_quality: The seller followed through on the promised technical review and communicated the result (evidence 4, 5).
manager_behavior.next_step_control: The seller's full-system alternative did not match the customer's current requirement, and no further option was agreed (evidence 5).

turning_points.description: The customer said it needed applicators integrated into its existing conveyor (evidence 3).
The customer sent a video of the current production line for technical review (evidence 4).
Production rejected the requested integration and the customer said not this time to the full-system alternative (evidence 5).

primary_trajectory_explanation.explanation: The decisive visible constraint was the customer's requirement to use its existing conveyor. Production said the applicators could not be integrated into that line and offered a complete system instead; the customer declined that alternative for now (evidence 3, 4, 5).

secondary_factors: The exact integration layout was only assessed after the customer sent video of the line (evidence 3, 4).
The initial container and output brief is recorded in a manager worklog (evidence 0).

what_could_be_done: Ask at intake whether the customer already has a conveyor and whether full-line replacement is acceptable before quoting (evidence 0, 2, 3).
Check integration feasibility with production before presenting a complete-line offer as the likely fit (evidence 3, 5).
limits: Production stated that this integration configuration could not be implemented (evidence 5).
The customer did not want the complete-system alternative at this time (evidence 5).

uncertainties: The initial performance and budget brief is in a manager worklog, not a customer-authored specification (evidence 0).
The customer declined the full-system alternative for the current need; the view does not show whether a different future configuration was explored (evidence 5).

evidence.paraphrase: Manager log describes a 10-liter flat canister, two side labels, and a target of 1,000 units per hour.
Customer emails a canister sketch and label examples with dimensions.
Seller sends a quote and a video for the proposed labeling equipment.
Customer says its existing conveyor is already in place and it needs only applicators integrated into that line.
Customer sends a video of the current line for technical review.
Seller reports production cannot install the applicators on the existing line and offers only a complete system; the customer replies, 'not this time'.
